name: Stool
overview: The concept of the stool in Scripture carries both literal and profound symbolic meaning. Physically, a stool is mentioned as part of a humble dwelling in 2 Kings 4:10, illustrating everyday life. Spiritually, the term 'footstool' frequently appears in the Psalms and Isaiah to denote God's sovereign authority and presence, with the earth described as His footstool (Isaiah 66:1) and His sanctuary as a place of worship (Psalms 99:5; 132:7). Furthermore, Psalm 110:1 highlights the victorious dominion of Christ, declaring that He will make His enemies His footstool, emphasizing His ultimate triumph and exaltation.
